papers.title: Rollout models of human planning with exact action probabilities.
papers.reason: The paper directly proposes and fits a tractable rollout-based computational model of human multi-step planning behavior.

papers.title: Nonverbal reasoning in children and adolescents with cerebral palsy: associations with gross motor function, MRI, and EEG findings.
papers.reason: It concerns clinical cognitive assessment with MRI and EEG in a human pediatric population, but the target construct is nonverbal reasoning rather than executive-function modelling or biomarker classification.

papers.title: Hidden Drowsiness in Wakefulness: Differences in Resting-State EEG Profiles in Natural Short Sleepers Versus Recommended Length Sleepers.
papers.reason: Resting-state EEG differences related to drowsiness and sleep duration may inform models of arousal and attention, but it is not centered on executive-function tasks or cognitive impairment assessment.

papers.title: NONPHARMACOLOGICAL REHABILITATION FOR POST-STROKE COGNITIVE IMPAIRMENT: FUNCTIONAL TRANSFER AND MAINTENANCE
papers.reason: The review addresses clinical cognitive rehabilitation and functional outcomes after stroke, but it does not specifically model or measure executive function, attention, or working memory mechanisms.

papers.title: Stability and flexibility in the Wisconsin Card Sorting Task emerge from goal-directed inference and planning under the free-energy principle
papers.reason: The paper directly proposes a free-energy computational model of WCST inference, planning, set maintenance, and set shifting, making it central to executive-function modelling.

papers.title: The effect of a sports-based cognitive game development program on attention level and frontal-midline (Fz) EEG theta/beta ratio
papers.reason: The study reports behavioural selective-attention changes alongside frontal EEG theta/beta measures, but it is an intervention study with exploratory neurophysiology rather than a mechanistic model.

papers.title: Acute high-intensity interval exercise in spinal cord injury: psychological benefits alongside cognitive and neurobiological responses
papers.reason: The paper examines working memory, prefrontal hemodynamics, and biomarkers in a clinical human group, but the cognitive effects are mostly null and the contribution is not computational.

papers.title: Distinct developmental organization of intrinsic brain dynamics supports different components of inhibitory control during adolescence
papers.reason: The paper directly links resting-state fMRI dynamics to developmental components of inhibitory control and contextual control, providing strong neuroscience evidence relevant to executive-function models.

papers.title: Neural processing of linguistic speech features and their modulation by selective attention in users of hearing aids and cochlear implants
papers.reason: The study uses EEG encoding models to examine selective attentional modulation of speech-feature processing, but its main focus is auditory-language processing in hearing impairment rather than executive function broadly.

papers.title: Brain Signal Variability and Brain–Behavior Coupling in Adults with Dyslexia
papers.reason: The paper includes working-memory and executive-function behavioural domains in brain–behavior analyses, but its core contribution is a dyslexia-focused resting-fMRI variability biomarker.
